export_qwen2_5_to_executorch: run optimum-cli to export Qwen2.5-0.5B model to ExecuTorch format with xnnpack recipe
load_qwen2_5_executorch_model: load a Qwen2.5-0.5B model from HuggingFace using ExecuTorchModelForCausalLM with a specified recipe

test_qwen2_5_custom_sdpa: run text generation test with Qwen2.5-0.5B using custom SDPA attention implementation
